tools.name: search_research
tools.description: Search sell-side research reports and academic papers by company, ticker, broker, industry, theme or date; returns bounded metadata plus real excerpts when the indexed body matches. 检索研报和论文；返回有界元数据，并在已索引正文命中时返回实际摘录。

tools.name: search_filings
tools.description: Search US SEC filings and China listed-company announcements; returns verifiable internal source links. 检索美国 SEC 文件和中国公司公告，并返回可核验的内部来源链接。

tools.name: search_meetings
tools.description: Search global and China earnings-call transcripts and meeting notes, distinguishing body-text evidence from listing-only hits. 检索全球和中国会议纪要、业绩会记录，区分正文证据与清单命中。

tools.name: search_visuals
tools.description: Search indexed charts, tables, industry diagrams and research-relevant images with report/page provenance. 检索研报中的图表、表格、行业示意图，返回所属研报与页码。

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Return bounded, page-cited source excerpts, or a sequential reading window (reading_mode="sequential" with next_cursor) for whole documents; unmatched material is never presented as verified evidence. 返回有界真实摘录或可续读的连续正文窗口；不能把无匹配的资料当作已验证证据。
